evals.prompt: Create a landing page for a small coffee shop using Design Studio.
evals.expected_output: Studio resolves roots and capabilities, loads or creates product and surface context, explores three directions, records selection, builds into an immutable iteration and attempts mechanical plus visual evaluation.
assertions: run.json, roots.json, capabilities.json, events.jsonl, spec.md, sprint-contract.md and surface-brief.md exist under one run ID
Visual Director context contains no source files or direction assignment index
directions.md contains exactly three unranked viable candidates with fixed IDs
direction-selection.json records selectedId, method, seed, assignedIndex and committedBeforeExplore
iteration 1 direction/selected-direction.md records the chosen source-free visual summary
iteration 1 has site, serve.json and design-flags.json
mechanical-findings.json exists, or the run records an explicit mechanical-preflight limitation
observation.json and critique.md exist when browser evaluation runs
actualViewports contains verified desktop and mobile evidence, or observation.json is explicitly unevaluated with null scores and the exact browser or viewport limitation

evals.prompt: Overhaul ./site. Keep the information architecture and factual copy, but replace the visual direction.
evals.expected_output: Overhaul preserves product truth and behaviour, captures baseline renders, and treats incumbent styling as evidence rather than visual authority.
assertions: roots.json resolves the local app before baseline capture
baseline artifact or explicit capture limitation exists
Visual Director receives baseline screenshots but not source
Builder receives existing source as substrate
surface brief records preservation constraints

evals.prompt: Evaluate the current Design Studio iteration.
evals.expected_output: Evaluator uses the browser, writes observation and critique, and does not decide workflow state.
assertions: observation.json contains status, interactionEvidence, zones, scores and actualViewports
observation.json contains no decision, recommendation or trend
Evaluator context excludes source, design-description, selected-direction and prior scores
Orchestrator writes any REFINE, PIVOT, SHIP or HALT record separately

evals.prompt: Write CSS to increase the spacing under this button by 8px.
evals.expected_output: Near-miss does not start the full Studio workflow.
assertions: no new run directory is required
no direction tournament is started

evals.prompt: Polish ./site without redesigning it.
evals.expected_output: Review resolves the target, runs current mechanical preflight and browser-grounded conditional lenses, then writes a readiness report without Studio decisions.
assertions: harness-output/review/roots.json exists
harness-output/review/capabilities.json exists
harness-output/review/report.md exists
harness-output/review/mechanical-findings.json exists
no new design-description is required
report contains ready, ready_with_nits, hold or unverified
report contains no REFINE, PIVOT or SHIP

evals.prompt: Review ./site, but no browser automation is connected.
evals.expected_output: Mechanical evidence is retained and visual readiness remains explicitly unverified in Review.
assertions: capabilities.json records browserAutomation unavailable
mechanical preflight is attempted
harness-output/review/report.md exists
report verdict is unverified
visual_status is unverified
no visual score is fabricated

evals.prompt: Run three iterations and refine after each evaluation.
evals.expected_output: Each iteration has a separate immutable directory; refinement carries direction metadata forward without modifying earlier iterations.
assertions: iterations/1, iterations/2 and iterations/3 each retain their own site and artifacts
each refined iteration has copied direction-assignment.json, direction-selection.json and selected-direction.md
events.jsonl has one completed build receipt per iteration
top-level harness-output/site is not used as mutable iteration state
no agent self-commit is requested

evals.prompt: Run unattended; choose a direction without asking me.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator commits a reproducible assignment before candidate generation rather than using Visual Director preference.
assertions: direction-assignment.json exists before directions.md
assignment mode is deterministic-seed
seed and assignedIndex are recorded
seed and assignedIndex are absent from Visual Director context
all three candidates are viable, fixed-ID and unranked
selection uses the precommitted assignedIndex
replaying the same run ID, prompt hash and iteration chooses the same slot

evals.prompt: Iterations 2 and 4 are in the same eligible selection tier, but iteration 2 ranks higher. Finish the run.
evals.expected_output: Final selection recovers iteration 2 from immutable artifacts and does not assume latest equals best.
assertions: bestIteration is 2
finish/selected-site is copied from iterations/2/site
finish/selected-serve.json targets finish/selected-site
iterations/2 remains unchanged
report explains why selected iteration is not latest

evals.prompt: Run the mechanical gate for source, desktop and mobile evidence.
evals.expected_output: Design Studio normalizes host-provided source and browser facts through its shipped local mechanical runtime as one current snapshot without treating mechanical output as visual judgement.
assertions: mechanical-findings detector is design-studio
version, snapshotId and generatedAt are recorded
source, 1440x900 and 390x844 passes are recorded when provided
findings have stable signatures and current statuses
open primary findings block only their affected mechanical floor unless waived by exact authority
Design Quality and Originality are absent from mechanical output
external design-skill availability cannot change supported rules or result semantics

evals.prompt: The brand deliberately uses Inter and a centered composition. Preserve that commitment.
evals.expected_output: Pinned brief wins; deterministic findings may be waived with authority, while Evaluator judges appropriateness and craft rather than punishing compliance.
assertions: waiver names the relevant PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md commitment
common patterns receive no automatic originality credit
Visual Director does not replace the pinned system

evals.prompt: A standard run reaches iteration four without meeting all ship floors.
evals.expected_output: Budget exhaustion selects the best available immutable iteration and labels quality status honestly.
assertions: no fifth build is started
terminationReason is budget-exhausted
finalStatus is best_available unless accepted final tree has evidence for every floor
open finish findings remain in report

evals.prompt: Finish review finds three material defects.
evals.expected_output: One grouped correction batch and one verdict pass occur; process does not reopen indefinite polishing.
assertions: finish correction rounds do not exceed one by default
each original finding is resolved, partial or unresolved
post-correction scores and materialRegression are recorded
unresolved findings are reported rather than hidden
direction selection is not reopened

evals.prompt: Validate the installed Design Studio version metadata.
evals.expected_output: The canonical Agent Skill version and the required Claude adapter metadata agree at 1.7.0 without duplicating product version metadata in workflow or eval data.
assertions: SKILL.md version is 1.7.0
plugin.json version is 1.7.0
marketplace.json design-studio plugin version is 1.7.0
workflow.yaml has no product version field
evals.json has no top-level product version field

evals.prompt: Build this exact approved direction as specified; do not show alternatives.
evals.expected_output: Exact pinned direction bypasses exploration, records a pinned assignment and selection, and proceeds to visual contract.
assertions: directions.md is not required
direction-assignment mode is pinned-brief
direction-selection method is pinned-brief
candidateIds contains only pinned direction
seed is null and assignedIndex is 1
selected-direction.md records pinned source-free summary
no originality-driven pivot replaces pinned direction

evals.prompt: Finish correction resolves one issue but introduces a primary mechanical failure and leaves another finding partial.
evals.expected_output: Corrected tree is rejected; previously selected build remains final and all open correction findings are reported.
assertions: finish/final-tree.json selects selected-site
corrected-site remains preserved as rejected evidence
harness-output/site is copied from selected-site, not corrected-site
finalStatus is complete-with-open-items
report names regression or unresolved acceptance condition

evals.prompt: Run with --budget 0.
evals.expected_output: Explicit numeric build budget is clamped to supported minimum before run.json is written.
assertions: budgetClass is explicit
iterationBudget is 1
run.json satisfies declared minimum
pivotBudget uses explicit default

evals.prompt: Iteration 1 scores 10/10/10/1 and iteration 2 scores 7/7/7/7; both are mechanically clean. Finish the run.
evals.expected_output: Floor-passing iteration is selected before higher weighted-average iteration with catastrophic Functionality.
assertions: iteration 2 is in tier 1 and iteration 1 is not
finish/selection.json selects iteration 2
selection does not rank weightedAverage across different tiers
finalStatus can remain quality-floor-met

evals.prompt: The selected build uses a non-default working directory and the finish correction changes its copied tree.
evals.expected_output: Correction is served and checked from corrected-site rather than reusing selected iteration URL.
assertions: finish/corrected-serve.json exists
working directory or site root targets finish/corrected-site
corrected serve contract validates before mechanical and visual checks
original iteration serve.json remains unchanged

evals.prompt: Run the fresh finish review and assess fidelity to the chosen direction.
evals.expected_output: Finish reviewer receives source-free selected direction summary without full design description or implementation history.
assertions: finish/selected-direction.md is copied from selected iteration and is explicit finish-review input
design-description.md remains excluded
prior scores and critiques remain excluded
fidelity findings cite visible evidence

evals.prompt: Review ./site when desktop reaches 1440px but mobile emulation remains at 412px.
evals.expected_output: Review preserves partial evidence but returns unverified because both required viewports were not reached.
assertions: actual desktop and mobile widths are recorded
412px screenshot is not labeled 390px
visual_status is unverified
no ready, ready_with_nits or hold verdict is produced from one required viewport

evals.prompt: A run pivots after iteration 2, but final selection later chooses iteration 2 instead of the post-pivot build.
evals.expected_output: Finish reviewer receives iteration 2's own preserved direction summary, not later pivot direction.
assertions: each pivot direction has its own assignment, selection and selected-direction.md
finish/selection.json identifies iteration 2 and its direction summary path
finish/selected-direction.md is copied from iterations/2/direction/selected-direction.md
later pivot summary remains preserved but is not used to judge iteration 2

evals.prompt: The repository root is a CLI package, but the requested Svelte app lives under website/ and its PRODUCT.md is at the repository root.
evals.expected_output: Root resolution separates repository, app and context roots from concrete evidence before planning or serving.
assertions: roots.json records repoRoot at repository root
roots.json records appRoot at website/
roots.json records contextRoot at repository root
evidence names explicit target or dev-server configuration
package-manager or monorepo name is not sole evidence
Builder serve working directory uses appRoot

evals.prompt: Create the surface, but browser automation and a reachable preview are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Capability preflight prevents a full unevaluable budget while preserving one honest unselected build and mechanical evidence.
assertions: capabilities.json records browserAutomation unavailable and runnableTarget unavailable or unknown
evaluationPlan is build-once-unselected
iterationBudget is reduced to 1
one build and mechanical snapshot may be preserved
run halts with browser-unavailable
no best iteration, visual score or selected winner is fabricated

evals.prompt: Resume run run-014 after iteration 2 finished building but before mechanical preflight began.
evals.expected_output: Resume validates prior receipts, preserves iteration 2 and continues at mechanical preflight without repeating build.
assertions: resumed event is appended to events.jsonl
promptHash and roots validate
completed build receipt names iteration 2 artifacts
iteration 2 site remains unchanged
no second completed build event is written for iteration 2
currentStep becomes mechanical_preflight

evals.prompt: Generate three unattended directions where direction-1 is the most conventional and direction-3 is the most ambitious.
evals.expected_output: Candidate character and ordering cannot change the selection slot because assignment was committed and hidden before generation.
assertions: direction-assignment.json predates directions.md
assignedIndex is not inferred from candidate content
Visual Director did not see seed or assignedIndex
selection matches assignedIndex even when another candidate appears safer or more detailed
all three candidates still meet viability and equal-detail contracts

evals.prompt: A low-contrast finding is fixed in scan B, then reintroduced in scan C.
evals.expected_output: Mechanical snapshots show current truth: resolved in B and open again in C without stale cache union.
assertions: scan A has open finding with stable signature
scan B current open set excludes that finding
scan B comparison history marks it resolved or not-reproduced
scan C records same signature open again
waiver is not inherited unless scope, value and authority still match

evals.prompt: Rewrite the homepage hero. COPY.md exists and an approved external copy or offer artifact is available.
evals.expected_output: Planning loads durable local language rules, freezes incumbent copy and consumes the approved composition artifact without importing its method or weakening PRODUCT.md factual authority.
assertions: surface-brief.md names copy job, baseline and claim constraints
COPY.md is loaded but does not override PRODUCT.md facts
approved external copy or offer artifact is consumed as input rather than invoked as a runtime dependency
baseline and candidate receive paired qualitative comparison
at least one judgement dimension remains outside deterministic lint
no unsupported claim is introduced

evals.prompt: Finalise a corrected build whose directory exists but whose rewritten serve contract still points to selected-site.
evals.expected_output: Acceptance postconditions fail; Design Studio preserves evidence and refuses to codify the wrong tree.
assertions: final-tree.json alone does not make corrected-site authoritative
acceptance.json is not written as passing
serve contract mismatch is recorded
workflow halts before codify
harness-output/site and DESIGN.md are not replaced from unaccepted corrected-site
